title: Kuzushi Module Manifest
description: Declarative manifest for a Kuzushi CopilotModule. Lives at the package root as `module.manifest.json` for file-based / package-based modules.

id.description: Unique kebab-case module id. Tool names must start with `<id>:`.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the shell's module catalog.

version.description: Semver of this module (independent of kuzushiSdkVersion).

entry.description: Entry module path, relative to the manifest.

kuzushiSdkVersion.description: Host SDK version the module was built against. A bare semver (0.19.1) or a range (>=0.19, ^1.0.0). The loader warns on major-version drift.

env.description: Environment variables that must be set.

bins.description: CLI binaries that must exist on PATH.

configSchema.description: Per-module config JSON Schema. Validated against `opts.moduleConfig` before init().
